meta.desc: iDisko is the social music app to meet people through what they listen to. Disko Room, song messages, Shuffle and VIP rooms. For adults 18+.

meta.ogDesc: Play a song and end up chatting with interesting people. Free on iPhone, Android and web.

hero.sub: Play a song and end up chatting with interesting people.
hero.orWeb: or use it on the web
hero.imgAlt: Silvia, online on iDisko, listening to Me gustas tú by Manu Chao

features.body: Open the Disko Room and see who's there and what they're playing. You can filter by age and profession. With Premium, by country and gender too.
features.alt: The iDisko Disko Room with people online and the song each one is playing

features.body: No need to know what to say: send a song with a short message. If they reply, the chat has already started.
features.alt: An iDisko chat that starts with a song

features.body: Turn on Shuffle and we introduce you to someone who turned it on too. If it doesn't click, you skip. No strings attached.
features.alt: The iDisko Shuffle screen introducing another person

features.body: Invite someone to a private room. If they accept, you both hear the same thing at the same time: when one changes the song, it changes for both. The camera is optional.
features.alt: An iDisko VIP room: two people listening to the same song

items.d: iDisko is an app for adults.
It only exists in VIP rooms and Shuffle. To turn it on you verify your age once with Yoti, and we don't keep your selfie.
An automated system moderates cameras. If it blocks you by mistake, write to us and a person reviews your case.
From their profile, at any time.

freeItems: Disko Room, song messages and Shuffle
plans.note: YouTube ads are shown by YouTube's player. iDisko does not remove them.

items.a: Yes. The essentials are free. Premium, with a 7-day free trial, adds unlimited VIP invitations (you get 10 per day for free), the country and gender filters, and shows you who opened your profile. YouTube ads are shown by YouTube's player and iDisko does not remove them.

items.q: Do I have to show my camera?
items.a: No. The camera is optional and only exists in VIP rooms and Shuffle. To turn it on you verify your age once.
Not exactly. On iDisko you meet people through the music they're listening to. Some make friends, some find a partner, and some just want company while they cook.

items.q: What music can I listen to?
items.a: Music from YouTube and from Jamendo, which is royalty-free music. You can search for a song or pick a ready-made playlist.

Rooms are not recorded. The camera is moderated with automatic snapshots: if the system detects nudity, the camera is turned off and we keep one snapshot to review the case. If you think it was a mistake, write to contact@idisko.com and a person will review it.
On iPhone, on Android and on the web, with the same account.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: From the app, in your account settings, or by following the steps on the Delete account page.

final.h: Your next chat|starts with a song
final.body: Get iDisko for free or open it on the web. The same account on both.
